title: Tenma Saki — Cookie Cheer〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're the one writing these, so I don't see any problems with you doing that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure, that may be true but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I like these lyrics more, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Again, I'm so sorry...
I'll keep trying.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I went through the same thing while I was writing my song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I tried and tried, but couldn't get anywhere for so long. I even started to doubt myself the more I thought about it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: As a result, I began to lose confidence in what I was doing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Isn't there anything I can do for Ichi...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So this is how everyone felt while I was writing my song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why they kept telling me to relax and not feel rushed.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Now, I'm beating myself up over not being able to help Ichi...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... Isn't there anything I can do...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You really surprised me there. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You girls seemed pretty down after you left practice, so I came to see how you were doing♪>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
That's so thoughtful of you, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hehe. It's my pleasure♪
I mean, we're all friends, right?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So, is what's going on with Ichi bothering you? How her lyrics are going and stuff...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, I see. Ichi's really struggling, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Is that why she's been coming to SEKAI at night lately?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So, uh... She's actually been coming over to SEKAI all by herself at night for a little while now.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I think she's been using that time to write lyrics while listening to your song, Sakki.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I want to try talking to her...
But Miku-P and the others keep saying that I shouldn't disturb her...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I didn't know that at all...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi's having to work so hard on this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh no! She's not staying up all night or anything, right?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Haha. Don't worry about that♪
She hasn't been going that far.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <If she does start doing that, I'm sure the Miku-P will intervene♪>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But if it's true that she's working that hard on this, I want to find a way to help her even more.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Times like these, I really wish I knew how to write lyrics...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, I'm not sure I can help her much either...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, I know! What if we brought her snacks and stuff?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that might be good!
Sweets are really the best cure for being tired!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, Rin, the coast is clear. Mom and Tsukasa aren't home, so it should be okay to come out!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Cookies! My mom made them the other day and should still have some ingredients left over from then.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And the recipe...
Oh, Rin, sorry. I need to look it up on my phone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, why don't I read everything off for you? That'll make things easier, right?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, here it is!
Alright, Rin, you're up!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Okay♪
Time to bake us some cookies♪>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(They're a little bur...
Well done with a nice aroma.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. Let's just leave these here for her.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(I believe in you, Ichi.
I know you're gonna write something amazing for us.)
